nodes.label: Public/internal API boundary
nodes.rationale: core mixes the public reactive API with framework internals; only a named subset (Signal/NewSignal/Computed/SignalAccessor/Schedule/Node/Component/ComponentNode/EventData/Ref/SVGNamespace) is public. The rest stays exported only because renderer packages share it across package boundaries — Go's internal/ visibility is per-package not per-identifier, and splitting core is a larger tracked refactor.

nodes.label: v0 stability policy
nodes.rationale: v0 allows breaking changes between minor releases (called out in CHANGELOG); renames keep the old name for one minor with a // Deprecated pointer. At v1 the public surface freezes under semver.

nodes.label: internal/dom — DOM renderer, diff, hydration, event registry
nodes.rationale: Under internal/ so the Go toolchain prevents any external module from importing it; there is no supported way to drive the renderer directly — go through bridge.Run (client) or ssr (server).

nodes.label: runtime/goowee.js — JS bridge (applies mutations, forwards events)
nodes.rationale: Implementation detail of the client, not a stable interface; applies mutations and forwards events, and hosts goowee.boot/log/inspect/devEnabled.

hyperedges.label: Public API packages under the v0 stability contract
